subject.title: [Bug]: Windows gateway listens but local health/status time out after Telegram polling stall (v2026.5.20)

question: Should repeated unrecovered Telegram/channel stalls escalate to supervised Gateway process recovery, or should recovery stay inside channel/session layers until a current-main affected-host repro identifies the exact blocker?
rationale: The source already has channel-level watchdogs and restart caps, but changing the cap into process exit or an external watchdog changes operator behavior and active-session recovery semantics.

options.title: Reproduce First, Then Choose Recovery
options.body: Keep this issue open, collect a current-main Windows or affected-host repro, and choose process-level recovery only if channel/session fixes still leave Gateway probes timing out.

options.title: Add Supervised Recovery Policy
options.body: Define a bounded Gateway watchdog or process-exit policy for unrecovered channel stalls and require upgrade notes plus Windows proof before landing.

options.title: Stay Channel-Scoped
options.body: Continue fixing narrower Telegram transport/session bugs and decline process-level recovery unless fresh proof shows it is required.

recommendation.title: Reproduce First, Then Choose Recovery
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, collect a current-main Windows or affected-host repro, and choose process-level recovery only if channel/session fixes still leave Gateway probes timing out.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the strongest recent Telegram polling watchdog commit and the live repro attempt that frames the remaining policy/proof gap.
